description: Banded pairwise alignment: only the cells of the diagonals diagonalLow .. diagonalHigh (j - i) of the dynamic program are computed, O(length1 x band) time and memory instead of O(length1 x length2) (30 000 x 30 000 residues with affine gaps: about 1 s instead of 98 s in the Debug build). mode global (default), local or semi_global (endGaps as in semi_global_align), linear (default) or affine gaps (gapOpen + k x gapExtend), match / mismatch or a matrix as in global_align. The alignment is the one of the full program (the same rows, score and coordinates) whenever the full alignment lies inside the band; otherwise the best alignment inside the band (never better than the full optimum). GLOBAL: bandWidth w gives the diagonals from min(0, n - m) - w to max(0, n - m) + w; exact = true (the default when no bandWidth is given) doubles the band from initialBandWidth until every path that leaves it is proven to score strictly less (Ukkonen's bound; the result is then the full program's alignment) and reports proven. LOCAL / SEMI-GLOBAL: give diagonalLow and diagonalHigh (a semi-global band must contain the diagonal 0). xDrop prunes cells more than X below the best score seen (BLAST gapped extension; a heuristic, equal to the banded result when X is at least the largest fall of the score along the optimal path). VERIFICATION: equal to GlobalAlign / GlobalAlignAffine / LocalAlign[Affine] / SemiGlobalAlign[Affine] field for field with a band that covers the matrix and with the full alignment inside a narrow band (seeded random pairs, linear / affine, scalar / BLOSUM62).

affine.description: true: affine gaps (gapOpen + k x gapExtend); false (default): linear gaps (every position costs gapExtend).

gapOpen.description: Gap-open score (affine only; <= 0). May be fractional when matrix is given.

gapExtend.description: Gap score per gap position (<= 0). May be fractional when matrix is given.

matrix.description: Optional substitution matrix: any built-in matrix by EMBOSS, NCBI or Biopython name - BLOSUM62, PAM250, EBLOSUM30 ... EBLOSUM90, EPAM10 ... EPAM500, BLASTP (BLOSUM62 with the residues U = selenocysteine, O = pyrrolysine and J = leucine / isoleucine, as blastp scores them), GONNET1992, JONES, DAYHOFF, MDM78, BENNER6 / 22 / 74, JOHNSON, RISLER, GENETIC, FENG, LEVIN, MCLACHLAN, RAO, STR (protein; the fractional ones are scored exactly) or EDNAFULL, EDNAMAT, EDNASIMPLE, ENUC.4.4, BLASTN, MEGABLAST, HOXD70, TRANS (IUPAC DNA); or THE TEXT of a matrix instead of a name: several lines in the NCBI / EMBOSS / Biopython data-file format (a header line of symbols, then one row per symbol: the symbol and its scores; # lines are comments; scores may be decimals). When given, match/mismatch are ignored, residues are scored by the published table (any protein or IUPAC symbol of the matrix; case-insensitive) and gapOpen/gapExtend may be fractional (the EMBOSS needle/water models: gapOpen = -(G - E), gapExtend = -E for -gapopen G -gapextend E). The result then also carries the real-valued exactScore.

bandWidth.description: global: the half-width w of the band beyond the corridor between the diagonal 0 and the end diagonal n - m (omit for the exact mode).

exact.description: global: double the band until the optimum is proven (default true when bandWidth is omitted).

initialBandWidth.description: exact mode: the first band half-width (default 16).

diagonalLow.description: local / semi_global: the lowest diagonal j - i of the band.

diagonalHigh.description: local / semi_global: the highest diagonal j - i of the band.

endGaps.description: Which end gaps are free (default 'Fitting' = the classic semi-global: free leading/trailing sequence2 residues). Comma-separated, case-insensitive names of the flags FreeStart1 (leading sequence1 residues free), FreeEnd1 (trailing sequence1), FreeStart2 (leading sequence2), FreeEnd2 (trailing sequence2) or of a preset: None (= global, all end gaps penalised; result tagged Global), Fitting (FreeStart2+FreeEnd2; sequence1 inside sequence2; parasail sg_dx, Biopython end_insertion_score=0), FittingSequence2 (FreeStart1+FreeEnd1; sequence2 inside sequence1; sg_qx), OverlapSuffix1Prefix2 (FreeStart1+FreeEnd2: a suffix of sequence1 overlaps a prefix of sequence2; sg_qb_de), OverlapSuffix2Prefix1 (FreeEnd1+FreeStart2; sg_qe_db), All (all four free; parasail sg, EMBOSS needle's default -endweight N). Example: 'FreeStart1,FreeEnd2'. startPosition1/endPosition1 and startPosition2/endPosition2 are the consumed intervals of each sequence (the free flanks lie outside them; an empty interval has end = start - 1); a free flank is shown against '-' in the aligned rows.

xDrop.description: X-drop pruning: cells more than xDrop below the best score so far are dropped (heuristic; omit for none).

errors.message: Unknown mode, a band that does not contain the origin / the end cell, a band wider than 64 000 000 cells per matrix, bandWidth negative, or no alignment inside the band

examples.name: Example
examples.output: the global alignment with proven = true (the rows of global_align)
